---
title: Costs and Getting Access
---

## How to request access

You can request access by filling in [this form](https://forms.gle/8ziuLPTWYivdf2em9) after **logging into Google using your VU credentials**. 
Don't have a VU google account, or ran into issues? 
Send us an email at [nebula.cs@vu.nl](mailto:nebula.cs@vu.nl).

## Are there costs involved?

Currently, Nebula offers a free-to-use pilot environment. However, Nebula is developing a paid production environment. The details are not fully crystallised yet. Contact [nebula.cs@vu.nl](mailto:nebula.cs@vu.nl) for more information. 

Note that there is an option to financially support the initiative for future developments (see above). If you need support for implementing something that requires substantial involvement from the team, costs will be invoiced.
